### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/components` (published).** One new export, `useIsViewportBelow(breakpoint)`. It answers whether the window is narrower than `breakpoint` CSS px: synchronously on the first render, then live through `matchMedia`. `useIsMobile` and the sidebar primitive are unchanged, and `components/src/ui/**` is untouched (ui/AGENTS.md #7). Additive.
- **`@object-ui/i18n` (published).** It gains one key, `sidebar.keepOpen`, in all ten packs. No key is renamed or removed. Additive.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` (private).**
  - `UnifiedSidebar` gains an optional `railOverlay` prop, off by default. With it off the sidebar is drawn as the provider says. The sidebar's wrapper changes from a fragment to a `display: contents` frame, which adds no box.
  - `useResponsiveSidebar` keeps its name and call site. The tablet-only auto-collapse (768–1023 px) becomes the fold below `CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_RAIL_BELOW_WIDTH` (1416), which covers that range.
  - A new reader preference, `console.sidebar.keepOpen`, is stored per browser and never in metadata.
  - A stash key, `os:console-sidebar:wide-open`, keeps the wide-window state while the fold holds the sidebar.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `components`, `i18n` and `app-shell`. That matches `Metadata-protocol: none`: AGENTS.md step 3 ships a non-protocol widening as `patch`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` is empty.
- The threshold of 1416 px is a declared deviation. The card's Target 1 says 1100 px, while its Acceptance and title imply 1280 folds and 1440 does not. It is derived in one named constant from the sidebar's width and is put to the epic seat at the preview. This is behaviour, not a contract matter.
- The screenshots are on `examples/app-crm` instead of HotCRM, as declared.

## 史诗席位预览核对请求 · epic:#26676#1

**To the epic seat** (`epic:#26676#1`, `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff`): #27593's Acceptance 3 asks you to verify this PR in the console preview before the seat posts ACCEPT (maintainer: 「车队开发完后你审核效果」). The seat holds the ACCEPT until you answer on this PR, with PASS or REWORK and the reason.

State on head `73cd185c4df7326b9f23aa1a6bb4880cc9f15024`, 2026-10-30T03:27Z: check-runs 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 failure. `mergeable_state` clean. NOT governed. Contract review 6514226609 PASS.

### What to look at

1. **1280 px window:** the console sidebar mounts as the icon rail, and the content is window − 48 px.
2. **Expand over content:** a click on the rail background, the app bar's sidebar button or ⌘B / Ctrl+B expands the full sidebar over the page, and the content does not move. A navigation choice, a press outside or Esc folds it again. A rail icon click still opens that entry, and hover does nothing.
3. **Keep sidebar open:** while the sidebar is expanded, its foot shows the new item. Pressing it keeps the wide sidebar on a narrow window across a reload, and pressing it again brings the fold back.
4. **1440 px:** nothing changes. Below the phone breakpoint the drawer is unchanged.
5. **The wide-window state is kept:** collapse on a wide window, narrow it, then widen it again; the collapsed choice comes back.

### Deviations to confirm or reject

- **The threshold is 1416 px, not 1100.** The card's Target 1 says 1100. Its Acceptance 1 and title need 1280 to fold and 1440 not to. 1416 = the split's 1160 px of content (list 440 + pane 720, #27545) + the 256 px sidebar, derived in `CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_RAIL_BELOW_WIDTH`. If you want another number, say which, and the dev changes the one constant.
- **HotCRM was not available in the dev container,** so the screenshots are on `examples/app-crm` (Contacts). The shell is app-independent.

domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaPpqK4cmqg5XJnjsj

Preview review (proxy for epic:#26676#1) · 18318361f74f8b1d1623f333efa9216bbd3a7170 · REWORK

Post-merge proxy preview review under ruling B (6520722066 on #26676), answering the "What to look at" list of 6514234395. Surface: `main` `18318361` (carries #27893), `examples/app-crm` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, console on its Vite dev server), Chromium via Playwright, Contacts (`/apps/com.example.crm/crm_contact`) plus Accounts, Leads, Opportunities, Pipeline. Reviewer: one context-free subagent whose only inputs were #27593's Acceptance, that list, the v4 boards (`a7825499aa`) and the console URL / sign-in. Every number is a `getBoundingClientRect` reading; `main` was sampled on every animation frame during each open and fold. Threshold graded at 1416 px per the ruling (measured: 1415 folds, 1416 does not). Report taken 2026-10-30T11:43Z.

**Overall: REWORK** on points 1, 2 and 5; points 3 and 4 PASS. Under the ruling's remedy these go to new cards under #26676, not a revert.

### 1. 1280 px window: icon rail, content = window − 48 · REWORK

- Settled state is right on all five pages: collapsed rail, 48 px, z-index 10, `main` at x 48, width 1232 from the first paint.
- **Fails:** when the last saved sidebar state was open (first visit with no saved state, first load after a wide window with the sidebar open, reload while the overlay was open), the first painted frame shows the sidebar panel at 256 px over the content, which then animates 256 → 152 → 100 → 48 over about 150–450 ms, covering "All Records" and the list rows. It loads straight at 48 px only when the last narrow state was folded.
- Shots: [settled rail](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p1-1280-rail.png) · [first frame 256](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p1-1280-first-load-frame-sidebar256.png) · [mid-shrink 82](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p1-1280-first-load-frame-sidebar82.png) · [load after a wide session, frame 256](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p1-1280-load-after-wide-session-frame-256.png)

### 2. Expand over content, fold, rail icons, hover · REWORK

- Works: rail-background click (5 spots), the app bar button, Ctrl+B and Meta+B open a 256 px overlay at z-index 40 with `main` at 48 / 1232 in every frame. Esc with focus on the page, an outside click (content or app bar), a navigation choice and a second toggle fold it; a group-heading click keeps it open. Rail icon clicks (Accounts, Opportunities, Pipeline) navigate and the rail stays 48. Hover 800 ms on an icon or the background leaves 48 px (only the label tooltip shows).
- **Fails:** with the pointer resting on an overlay menu item (hover 900 ms on "Accounts") or keyboard focus on a menu item or on "Keep sidebar open", the first Esc leaves the overlay open at 256 px; only the second Esc folds it. Reproduced with all three ways of opening and with Tab focus on "Leads" / "Accounts". The first Esc is taken by an invisible item tooltip (`role=tooltip`, `display:none`) that opens on hover or focus inside the expanded overlay.
- Shots: [overlay, rail-bg click](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p2-1280-overlay-rail-bg-click.png) · [overlay, Ctrl+B](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p2-1280-overlay-ctrl-b.png) · [after nav choice](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p2-1280-after-nav-choice.png) · [hover on rail icon](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p2-1280-hover-rail-icon.png) · [hovered item, after first Esc](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p2-overlay-hover-item-after-esc1.png) · [focus on nav link, not folded](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p2-esc-focus-on-nav-link-not-folded.png)

### 3. Keep sidebar open · PASS

The expanded overlay's foot shows "Keep sidebar open" (239×36). Pressed, the sidebar docks at 256 px with `main` at 256 / 1024; Esc, outside click and navigation no longer fold it; after a reload and in a new tab it is still 256 + 1024. Pressed again, the rail returns (48 + 1232) and that survives a reload too.
Shots: [foot item](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p3-1280-expanded-foot-item.png) · [kept open after reload](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p3-keep-open-after-reload.png) · [after unpin + reload](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p3-after-unpin-reload.png)

### 4. 1440 px unchanged; phone drawer unchanged · PASS

1440: docked 256 px, `main` 256 / 1184, no foot item; Esc, outside click, hover and navigation do nothing; Ctrl+B collapses to an ordinary docked 48 px strip with `main` 48 / 1392; reload keeps the state. 700: no desktop sidebar, `main` 0 / 700; the app bar button or Ctrl+B opens the 288 px drawer (z-index 50, backdrop, no keep-open item); Esc or a backdrop click closes it. 767 px gives the drawer, 768 the rail. (No pre-merge build was compared; "unchanged" = none of the new rail / overlay / keep-open behaviour appears.)
Shots: [1440](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p4-1440.png) · [1440 after Ctrl+B](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p4-1440-collapsed-ctrl-b.png) · [700 drawer](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p4-700-drawer.png)

### 5. The wide-window state is kept · REWORK

- Works: collapse at 1440 (48 + 1392) → 1280 (rail, 48 + 1232) → 1440 gives collapsed 48 + 1392 again; also with overlay use in between, a reload at 1280, widening while the overlay is open, and expanded → narrow → wide (256 + 1184).
- **Fails:** turning "Keep sidebar open" on and then off on the narrow window overwrites the wide-window choice. Collapse at 1440 → 1280 → open overlay → keep open on → off (rail back at 48 + 1232) → 1440: expected collapsed 48 + 1392, got expanded 256 + 1184, still expanded after a reload; 3 of 3 runs. The reverse also breaks: expanded at 1440 → 1280 → keep open on → Ctrl+B → keep open off → widen gives collapsed 48 + 1392 though nothing was collapsed on the wide window. With keep open left on, widening shows 256 px instead of the collapsed wide choice.
- Shots: [1440 collapsed](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p5-S1-1440-collapsed.png) · [1280 rail](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p5-S1-1280-rail.png) · [1440 collapsed restored](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p5-S1-1440-collapsed-restored.png) · [after keep-open on/off: expanded instead of collapsed](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/p5-S7-repeat-1440-expanded-instead-of-collapsed.png)

### The boards

No v4 board shows the narrow-window sidebar (no 48 px rail, overlay or keep-open item). The seven desktop boards (RecordPageV4*, RecordDrawerV4*) draw a fixed expanded sidebar 200 px wide with ☰ in the top bar; SidebarReports shows four 220 px sidebar mock-ups about "All reports"; RecordMobile shows phones with ☰ and no sidebar. The live expanded sidebar is 256 px against the boards' 200 / 220; not graded. [Example board shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/e1844a1f/evidence/27593-proxy/shots/board-RecordDrawerV4Peek.png)

### Other observations (not verdicts)

1. With keep open on, Ctrl+B or the app bar button collapses to a docked 48 px strip that looks like the rail but carries the pin at its foot; a background click there does nothing, and it stays collapsed after a reload although keep open is still on.
2. With a record open in a modal with a backdrop (Contacts → Grace), Ctrl+B opens the sidebar overlay behind that backdrop, unseen and unusable; one Esc then both folds the hidden overlay and closes the record.
3. At 700 px, choosing a page in the drawer navigates but leaves the drawer open (may be prior behaviour).
4. During loading the rail briefly shows a generic database icon for every entry before the real icons arrive.

Evidence (never-merged branch `claude/issue-27593-proxy-evidence` @ `e1844a1f`, folder `evidence/27593-proxy/`): all shots, `readings/readings.json` (summary + raw readings) and the Playwright scripts.
